description: This file defines a frame processor class 'FunctionFilter' that filters frames in a processing pipeline based on a user-defined asynchronous filter function. It applies filtering logic considering different frame types and processing directions.

classes.name: FunctionFilter
classes.description: A frame processor that filters frames using a user-provided asynchronous filtering function, with options to control filtering of system frames and processing direction.

methods.name: __init__( self, filter: Callable[[Frame], Awaitable[bool]], direction: FrameDirection = FrameDirection.DOWNSTREAM, filter_system_frames: bool = False, )
methods.description: Initializes the FunctionFilter with a custom filter function, processing direction, and whether to filter system frames.

methods.name: _should_passthrough_frame(self, frame, direction)
methods.description: Determines whether a frame should bypass filtering based on its type and processing settings.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Processes a frame, applies filtering logic asynchronously, and decides whether to pass the frame downstream.
